Description

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_8 - Reserved

Bytes 1-3 are padding introduced by the DWORD-aligned RDL view and are not part of the current placeholder payload.

VENDOR_DATA - Vendor placeholder byte

Byte 0 placeholder for the vendor-defined command space. This project currently models only one byte, reset to 0. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 VENDOR command summary.
